question: Who has been appointed as the second Chief of Defence Staff of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lieutenant General Anil Chauhan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anil Chauhan** is an** Indian Army general** with four stars.
 
• Since **September 30, 2022**, he has served as the Indian Armed Forces' **second Chief of Defence Staff** (CDS).
 
• The Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) is a **four-star general rank **officer who serves as the principal military advisor to the government of India.
 
• The CDS is responsible for ensuring jointness and integration among the three services -** Army, Navy, and Air Force** - in terms of operations, logistics, training, and procurement.
 
• The CDS was created as a new position in the Indian armed forces in** 2019**, and **General Bipin Rawat **became the first CDS.
 
• The appointment of the CDS is a significant step towards achieving **greater synergy and coordination** among the Indian armed forces, and it is expected to enhance India's national security and defence preparedness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **General Manoj Mukund Naravane** is the current **Chief of Army Staff **(COAS) of the Indian Army.

 
 
• He assumed office on **31 December 2019.**
 
 
 
• Lieutenant General **Baggavalli Somashekar Raju** is a serving officer in the Indian Army.
 
 
• He is currently the** General Officer Commanding-in-Chief **(GOC-in-C) of the Army Training Command (ARTRAC) in Shimla.
